request.spec:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not
clash (and leaves no clashing alias).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not
clash (and leaves no clashing alias).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A name or alias can no longer be used on a sheet if any sheet in its tree already uses it. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**What's refused** (case and outer spaces ignored, as before):
- **Tree:** the sheet itself, its parent, grandparent and so on (among sheets that exist), and all its descendants. I read the request literally, so **sibling sheets are not included**. If you meant the whole tree under the root, that's a one-line change in `People.tree`.
- **Adding a person, adding an alias, renaming:** these now go through the existing duplicate check (`People.nameTaken`), which looks across the tree.
- **Quick-add bar:** refused only when it would create a new person whose name is used elsewhere in the tree. A name that matches someone on the sheet itself still adds the claim to them.
- **Paste box:** unchanged. It only ever matches people on the sheet itself and refuses unknown names, so it already can't create a duplicate.
- **Import:** the app has no import feature, so there was nothing to change.
- **Transfer:** I also applied the check to the destination sheet's tree, leaving out the person being moved. Otherwise a move between a parent and its child would clash with itself.

**People who already clash:**
- Each row has a new Clashing column (`person-clashing`) showing "yes" when the person's name or any alias is used by someone else in the tree.
- An edit through the person form is refused unless the new name clashes with no one and none of their aliases clash either (`ApplyPerson`).
- Setting a sheet's parent is still allowed even when it creates clashes, which the test expects.

**One UI fix the test needed:** after a refused save, pressing Edit again on the same person didn't refill the form, so the old typed values were submitted again. Each press of Edit now reloads the person's stored values, using a small counter in the new file `features/people/editorOpens.ts`.

The main code is in `person/People.java`, with changes also in `ApplyPerson`, `AddAlias`, `SavePersonCreated`, `TransferPerson`, `claim/SaveQuickClaim`, `Person`, `PersonResponse`, `usePeople.ts`, `PeopleList.tsx` and `PersonForm.tsx`. No database migration was needed.
